entities.summary: Hadiza Isma El-Rufai is a Nigerian writer (novelist), and wife to the former governor of Kaduna State, Mallam Nasir El-Rufai. She was the founder of Yasmin El-rufai Foundation (YELF), a non-profit literary organization. Her first novel is titled: "An Abundance of Scorpions".
